generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Tenderers registered in BBMP or equivalent registration of KPWD/CPWD or any state governmental organization for the execution works

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26).Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (one similar work) of Rs 19.93 Lakhs

Tenderers who meet the specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. Tender available tender capacity will be calculated as under for assessed available tender capacity refer the tender document
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
For any other conditions refer the tender document
Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar work/Civil work of value not less than Rs.9.96 Lakhs
The rates quoted by contractor against individual items shall be Inclusive of GST
Regardless of any labour related issues that may arise bidder will be the sole responsible person

itemList.description: 4 SEATER SEE SAW The See Saw consists of 2 poles of Dia 114mm and thickness of 2.5mm which balances the horizontal rod at the center which is of size 3110 mm length and Dia 114 mm. It consists of 4 seats which is made of FRP of size 305mm X 213 mm X 125 mm. We have ISO certificate & MSME certificate and we truly abide by MAKE IN INDIA.

MULTIPURPOSE PLAY SYSTEM Upright structural posts of height 2.2 m and 3.0 m are to be schedule HOT DIP Galvanized steel with a 114mm OD and 2.2mm (wall) thickness of the tubing. The poles are welded on to a base plate made from steel with 114mm inner diameter. Decks of size 1.45 x 1.45m are fabricated from 2mm perforated solid punched steel. The entire 1 item is powder coated. Deck Perimeter is precision pre punched for attachments. Decks are pressed, punched, and welded sand blasted and vinyl plastic coated to a thickness of 4 mm. Deck perimeters is precision pre punched for attachments. Rooftop of size 2.7 m x 1.8 m x 0.8 m, Straight Slide of size 2.22 m x 0.82m x 1.50 m, Straight Slide of size 1.72 m x 0.82 m x 1.20 m Snake Ladder Climber of thickness Dia 38 mm, Frisbee Climber, Panels. We have ISO certificate & MSME certificate and we truly abide by MAKE IN INDIA.

Hexa climber Upright structural posts of height 2.6 m are to be schedule HOT DIP Galvanized steel with a 114mm OD and 2.2mm (wall) thickness of the tubing. Top rail Bars Dia 32 mm are all robotic welded fabricated from 48MM O.D. galvanized steel pipes for the outer bars and 32 mm OD galvanized steel for the inner parallel bars with a baked on powder coat finish Net Climber of size 2.1 m are all robotic welded fabricated from 32 O.D. galvanized steel pipes for the outer pipes and 25mm O.D. galvanized steel for the inner parallel bars with a baked on powder coat finish.

Merry go round The Merry go round consists of a round platform which is made of galvanized steel and has a thickness of 2.5 mm. It is also power coated with the thickness of 2.5 mm. It is of Dia 1210 mm. It has 3 inverted “L” shaped handrails which is made of Galvanized steel and of dimensions as 474 mmx 815 mm. It has thickness of Dia 32 mm. The 3 handrails are separated exactly. All the 3 handrails are connected to the Centre with the help of a rod which is also made of Galvanized steel and of Dia 48 mm and height 815 mm.

Standard swing 2 seater 7’ht with FRP bucket seats Inverted U shaped structural posts of height 2.31 m are to be schedule HOT DIP Galvanized steel with a 114mm OD and 2.2mm (wall) thickness of the tubing. Toprail at height 2.31 m and Dia 114 mm shall be an allrobotic welded unit, fabricated from 114 O.D. Plastic Components such as swing seats [super thick plastic] shall be animated and shall be rotationally molded from antistatic, copolymer, virgin linear low density UV stabilized polyethylene, with color molded in and minimum thickness of 6 - 8mm
